content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization or medical-necessity denial, and the claim facts do not identify a valid coding correction or modifier that would support resubmission. A peer-to-peer has already been requested, while duplicate or unsupported resubmission risks another denial; the patient also has no contractual share to bill. A billing specialist must review the other paid service and bundling/edit details before any further payer action."}
